questions.question: Describe the purpose, features, advantages and disadvantages of experimental method.
questions.solution_html:
• Purpose: The experimental method is a method of studying children through experiments
  • conducted in a controlled setting to understand behaviour, learning, and development. (2½
  • marks)
  • Features: Controlled Setup, Testing Cause and Effect, Groups for Comparison, Repeatable
  • Results. (2½ marks)
  • Advantages: Gives clear and reliable results, Helps find out what causes certain behaviors
  • Reduces errors by controlling other factors. (2½ marks)
  • Limitations: Children may act differently in an artificial setting, Some experiments may raise
  • ethical concerns, The results may not always apply to real-life situations. (2½ marks)
questions.final_answer: ethical concerns, The results may not always apply to real-life situations. (2½ marks)

questions.question: Describe the purpose, features, advantages and disadvantages of experimental method.
questions.solution_html:
• Purpose: The experimental method is a method of studying children through experiments
  • conducted in a controlled setting to understand behaviour, learning, and development. (2½
  • marks)
  • Features: Controlled Setup, Testing Cause and Effect, Groups for Comparison, Repeatable
  • Results. (2½ marks)
  • Advantages: Gives clear and reliable results, Helps find out what causes certain behaviors
  • Reduces errors by controlling other factors. (2½ marks)
  • Limitations: Children may act differently in an artificial setting, Some experiments may raise
  • ethical concerns, The results may not always apply to real-life situations. (2½ marks)
questions.final_answer: ethical concerns, The results may not always apply to real-life situations. (2½ marks)
